title: Barthen’s Provisions

sourceRecords.title: 3 · Clues after the road fight
read: The woods settle. The two horses still block the road. Broken brush and small tracks lead north, away from the wagon and into thicker trees.
Among the goblins’ castoffs is a rough dark stone token. One side bears a single worn word: BELOW. The other carries part of a circle rubbed almost smooth.

sourceRecords.title: 2 · Barthen’s Provisions
read: Warm lamplight falls over rope, trail food, tools, and stacks of ledgers. Behind the counter, a thin shopkeeper looks up. His welcoming smile falters as he counts the faces coming through the door. “Where is Gundren?”

The shelves are arranged for practical journeys rather than impressive purchases: coils of rope, provisions, and tools ready to be carried away. The counter is a place to set down goods or ask for help, and the shopkeeper waits to hear which business brought you through his door.

sourceRecords.title: Lead · Business with Barthen
read: Rope coils hang beside trail rations and stacks of useful things. Barthen lays down a pencil as you approach. “Tell me what you need,” he says, looking from one face to the next.

The counter offers room to set down goods or explain what brought you here. Barthen waits for your account rather than supplying one of his own. You can ask for ordinary equipment, discuss the supplies, or tell him only as much of your recent trouble as you choose.
